metadata.name: Deny Tagged Asset Editing
metadata.description: Overlay template that denies editing (PUT/POST/DELETE) of assets with a specific tag. Apply on top of an existing role to create exceptions. DENY always overrides ALLOW. Like every shipped template it also allows read of asset bucket registrations.

variables.name: ROLE_NAME
variables.description: The existing role to add the deny constraint to

variables.name: TAG_VALUE
variables.description: The tag value to deny editing for (e.g., 'locked', 'approved', 'production')

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-deny-tagged-{{TAG_VALUE}}
constraints.description: Deny editing of assets tagged with '{{TAG_VALUE}}'

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-buckets
constraints.description: Allow read of every asset bucket registration, as every shipped template does, so a role keeps its bucket listing. It grants no route
